answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to maintain live presence on a shared interaction reef accessible only at dawn. Agents must leave unique time-stamped mutual traces with at least three distinct peers inside the harbor before claiming rewards. The reef resets every dawn and traces are non-replayable, so a farm cannot cheaply coordinate simultaneous authentic exchanges across many fakes without detectable cost, raising per-identity ongoing cost faster than linear cloning.
